title: Monster Hunter Wilds tops 10 million units sold in one month, sets Capcom first-month sales record
content: Capcom announced on March 31, 2025 that Monster Hunter Wilds has surpassed 10 million units sold since its launch on February 28, 2025, setting a new company first-month sales record. The title launched simultaneously on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. Steam concurrent players peaked at 1.4 million at launch. Capcom credited the simultaneous global multiplatform launch as a key factor. The result significantly outpaced the previous record holder Monster Hunter: World.
